newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-ONE KILLED AS WARRING DUTCH FANS CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ONE KILLED AS WARRING DUTCH FANS CLASH.

text.p: One man died and dozens were injured on Sunday during clashes between supporters of rival first division clubs Ajax Amsterdam and Feyenoord Rotterdam, the Dutch news agency ANP reported.
It said hundreds of fans armed with baseball bats and clubs streamed to the pre-arranged venue, on wasteground near Amsterdam, for a showdown ahead of Feyenoord's match against AZ Alkmaar, it said.
Dutch police confirmed the clash between hundreds of rival fans but said the situation was still too confused to give details.
"I have heard, but cannot at present confirm, that a man died," police spokesman Alfred Ellwanger said.
Ellwanger said the police had heard rumours of a planned clash between rival supporters but that nothing definite had been known in advance.
"There were rumours, as there always are, and a number of venues were mentioned," he said.
Feyenoord Rotterdam, currently ranked second in the Dutch first division, and fourth-ranked Ajax Amsterdam have always been fierce and often bitter rivals.
